identity.fantasy: A battlefield corpse general who spends Life Force on a configurable undead army, then directs it with commands, frenzy, artillery, and marching dead.
identity.one_line: The dedicated army tree. It spends Life Force on archers, abominations, constructs, and named undead, then uses Command spells and March of the Dead to direct them. Recent discussion reports very high output from simple current builds, which may make the realized rotation easier than the intended summon roster suggests.

mechanics.core_loop: Choose an army composition, spend Life Force on archers, ghouls, an abomination, or later constructs, apply Blight and Crypt Swarm, use Command: Undead as the active pet payoff, fire instant Lichfrost when Bone King procs, and align skeletal archers, Unholy Frenzy, or March of the Dead with larger pulls and bosses.

modes.name: Ghoul Mastery
modes.structural_description: Damage dealt by your Ghouls now has a 15% chance to transform them into a Frenzied Ghoul.Frenzied Ghoul (Proc)Transformed into a Frenzied Ghoul, increasing haste by 40% for 10 seconds. Immune to movement slowing effects.

modes.name: Flesh Symbiosis
modes.structural_description: Each Abomination or Decaying Colossus active now increases your total Armor and magic resistance by 30% and causes you to periodically regenerate 2% maximum health every 5 sec.

modes.name: Animate: Bone Construct
modes.structural_description: Animate a Bone Construct to aid you in combat for 20 seconds.It moves at a slow speed, but upon reaching an enemy, deals 1560 + 200% SP + 50% AP Shadow damage, piercing all invulnerabilities, resistances, and immunities.

mechanics.single_target: Current leveling guidance uses an abomination plus ghouls for safe solo play, Blight and Crypt Swarm to open, Command on cooldown, instant Lichfrost procs, skeletal archers on cooldown, and Unholy Frenzy for bosses.
mechanics.aoe: Multiple ghouls, skeletal artillery, March of the Dead, corpse effects, and later construct options scale the army into packs.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Minions preserve damage while the player moves, but current reports repeatedly warn that pet pathing, unwanted aggro, and target selection can work against the player.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Fetid Ward, ghoul healing, sacrifice tools, Anti-Magic Shell, and Flesh Symbiosis give strong self-sustain when the army behaves correctly.
mechanics.group_utility: Corpse Wagon supplies a non-stacking damage aura; undead bodies, slows, and pet control add indirect group value.

failure_modes.text: A poor army composition or failed pet path can consume Life Force and pull enemies without delivering the intended damage or protection.

Movement or a target swap can interrupt the intended payoff: minions preserve damage while the player moves, but current reports repeatedly warn that pet pathing, unwanted aggro, and target selection can work against the player.

Spending recovery or control too early leaves less protection for the next pressure event: fetid ward, ghoul healing, sacrifice tools, anti-magic shell, and flesh symbiosis give strong self-sustain when the army behaves correctly.

enjoy_if.text: You want a persistent undead army to carry damage and protection while you issue active commands.

You enjoy the spec's core cadence: choose an army composition, spend life force on archers, ghouls, an abomination, or later constructs, apply blight and crypt swarm, use command: undead as the active pet payoff, fire instant lichfrost when bone king procs, and align skeletal archers, unholy frenzy, or march of the dead with larger pulls and bosses.

avoid_if.text: Unreliable pet movement, unwanted aggro, or managing multiple temporary summons quickly frustrates you.

You dislike the positioning or swap constraint that minions preserve damage while the player moves, but current reports repeatedly warn that pet pathing, unwanted aggro, and target selection can work against the player.

praise.theme: Players praise its leveling safety, self-sustain, and strong minion output once ghouls and an abomination are online.

frustrations.theme: Pet AI, random pulls, stuck minions, and early multi-button setup are the dominant complaints.

contested.theme: Some current players call Animation strong and safe while others call it clunky and weak; build, level, and pet behavior appear to explain part of the split.

claims.text: A current level-43 Animation player recommends one abomination plus ghouls for solo play, full ghouls for dungeons, Blight and Crypt Swarm to open, Command when available, instant Lichfrost procs, skeletal archers on cooldown, and Unholy Frenzy for bosses; Fetid Ward and ghouls provide sustain.
claims.notes: Detailed working leveling loop, not proven optimal at 60.

claims.text: Recent Necromancer discussions report minions pulling unintended targets, attacking random enemies, getting stuck, and requiring more actions than comparable classes; other players report the same army as safe and strong.
claims.notes: Behavior likely varies by terrain, pet composition, and player control.

claims.text: The July DPS compilation reports Animation at 4,702, and the August Mythic inventory lists 169 Animation records, the largest Necromancer spec count in that source.
claims.notes: Neither signal controls for army composition, gear, or player skill.

claims.text: Animation pays for army mistakes twice: Life Force is committed to the summon and a failed pet path withholds both damage and protection.
claims.notes: Recovery time depends on remaining Life Force and summon cooldowns.

claims.text: Animation's intended summon roster is broad, but current working builds may reduce moment-to-moment play to a smaller command, proc, archer, frenzy, and stable-pet subset.
claims.notes: Needs level-60 build comparison.
